title: Column: Tin breaks higher as Indonesia cracks down on illegal miners
body: The tin market is once again bubbling on supply chain trouble, this time in Indonesia.

title: Indonesia’s Merdeka starts mining at Pani gold project
body: The company aims to produce 140,000 ounces of gold annually.

title: Freeport-McMoRan still in talks with Indonesia over Grasberg mine rights
body: PT Freeport Indonesia is 51% owned by Indonesia's government but operated by Freeport.

title: Freeport to divest 12% of mine to Indonesia, CNBC says
body: The divestment is part of an agreement to extend the company’s license to operate the Grasberg mine.

title: Indonesia halts Grasberg operations to search for trapped workers
body: Two workers have died and five remain missing following a large mudflow earlier this month.

title: Freeport mine setback risks fraying relations with Indonesia
body: Grasberg has long been a flashpoint as Jakarta tries to gain a greater say over its resources.

title: APNI Reports Early October 2025 Nickel Prices Rise to $15,101.67 per DMT, Calls for Benchmark Adjustments
body: APNI announced that nickel prices in the first half of October 2025 climbed to US$15,101.67 per dmt, up from US$15,000.33 in mid‑September, with benchmark prices varying from US$28.75 to over US$40 per wmt depending on grade and moisture content. The association praised the transparency of the calculation formula but urged the government to adjust the benchmark to better reflect market realities, especially for low‑grade domestic miners.

title: Merdeka Battery Reports 78% Rise in Nickel Ore Production Amid Revenue Decline, Focus on Upstream Expansion
body: In the first half of 2025, Merdeka Battery’s nickel ore output surged 78% to 6.9 Mt wmt, driven by 45% growth in limonite and 189% in saprolite, while revenue fell 32% to $628 M; downstream NPI production dropped 23% to 33,045 t due to smelter maintenance but cash cost fell below $10k/ton. The company also sold 9,465 t of mixed hydroxide precipitate, advanced its HPAL and slurry pipeline projects toward mid‑2026, and recorded a Q2 EBITDA up 33% YOY after adjusting for lower HGNM output.
